description: This file defines an interface for shared channel services in Mattermost, along with a mock implementation for testing purposes. It includes method signatures for managing shared channels, notifications, and remote cluster interactions.

classes.name: mockSharedChannelService
classes.description: A mock implementation of the SharedChannelServiceIFace interface for testing purposes, with additional fields to track notifications and invitations.

methods.name: NotifyChannelChanged
methods.description: Records a channel change notification and forwards it to the underlying service if available.

methods.name: NotifyUserProfileChanged
methods.description: Records a user profile change notification and forwards it to the underlying service if available.

methods.name: Shutdown
methods.description: Shuts down the service, delegating to the underlying service if available.

methods.name: Start
methods.description: Starts the service, delegating to the underlying service if available.

methods.name: Active
methods.description: Checks if the service is active, delegating to the underlying service if available.

methods.name: SendChannelInvite
methods.description: Increments invitation count and delegates the invite to the underlying service if available.

methods.name: NumInvitations
methods.description: Returns the number of invitations sent.

methods.name: HandleMembershipChange
methods.description: Delegates membership change handling to the underlying service if available.

methods.name: IsRemoteClusterDirectlyConnected
methods.description: Checks if a remote cluster is directly connected, defaulting to true if remoteId is empty.
